executive_summary: Selected 5 recent exploited vulnerabilities and security advisories relevant for student portfolio: auth bypass, XSS, ReDoS, deserialization, and AI supply chain RCE. Includes a safe ReDoS reproduction experiment.

signals.title: Budibase: Unauthenticated global-admin & database creation via tenant-confusion bypass
signals.what_changed: Authentication bypass in one-time init endpoint allows unauthenticated attacker to create global admin and database.
signals.why_it_matters: Demonstrates critical auth logic flaw in multi-tenant apps; ideal for studying authorization bypasses and secure initialization patterns.
signals.application: Reproduce in local Budibase instance; write secure code review checklist for init endpoints; add to portfolio as auth bypass case study.

signals.title: Budibase: Cross-privilege Stored XSS via broken HTML-escaping in jsonFormatter.format()
signals.what_changed: Stored XSS in Builder due to improper HTML escaping when rendering user-controlled JSON via {@html} in CSP-less origin.
signals.why_it_matters: Shows real-world XSS from template rendering flaws; teaches output encoding, CSP importance, and secure frontend practices.
signals.application: Set up Budibase, inject payload, observe execution; create mitigation guide for JSON-to-HTML rendering; include in secure coding portfolio.

signals.title: wcmatch: Polynomial-time ReDoS when matching untrusted names against multi-star patterns
signals.what_changed: Default flags allow catastrophic backtracking on crafted patterns with multiple stars, causing polynomial-time DoS.
signals.why_it_matters: Classic ReDoS example in widely used library; teaches regex safety, complexity analysis, and defensive input validation.
signals.application: Reproduce ReDoS with minimal script; compare vulnerable vs patched versions; write blog post on regex hardening for portfolio.

signals.title: Apache Roller deserialization of untrusted data via XML-RPC endpoint
signals.what_changed: Unauthenticated remote code execution via deserialization of vendor extension types in XML-RPC before authentication.
signals.why_it_matters: Represents prevalent deserialization vulnerability class; essential for understanding Java deserialization risks and mitigation strategies.
signals.application: Study CVE details; use safe deserialization labs (e.g., marshalsec) to practice detection; document secure coding rules for serialization.

signals.title: BerriAI LiteLLM: Unprotected alternate channel allowing RCE via bytecode rewriting at /guardrails/test_custom_code
signals.what_changed: Remote code execution through bytecode rewriting in custom guardrail testing endpoint, affecting AI gateway security.
signals.why_it_matters: Highlights emerging AI/ML supply chain risks; shows how dynamic code execution features can be abused in LLM infrastructure.
signals.application: Analyze advisory for secure AI gateway design; build threat model for LLM plugin systems; add to portfolio as AI security case study.

experiment.title: ReDoS Detection and Mitigation in wcmatch Library
experiment.objective: Understand ReDoS vulnerability class, reproduce polynomial-time matching, and apply safe regex practices.
steps: Install vulnerable wcmatch version in isolated virtual environment
Craft a multi-star pattern (e.g., '**/*') and generate long input strings with repeated separators
Measure execution time for increasing input lengths to observe polynomial growth
Upgrade to patched version (>=8.4) or apply safe pattern alternatives
Re-run test to verify linear time handling
expected_evidence: Execution time increases polynomially with input length on vulnerable version
Patched version handles same input in linear time
Documentation of regex pattern that caused ReDoS and mitigation applied
experiment.stop_condition: If execution exceeds 10 seconds or system becomes unresponsive, terminate immediately.
